# agent-council

Convenes a council of independent expert agents, each blind to the others and fixed to one lens, to review a plan, decision, document set or strategy. Findings are adjudicated against the primary sources, not against each other. A corpus mode freezes and hashes the inputs before review. An optional author rebuttal round tests the contested findings. Use when asked to "convene a council", "agent council", "blind review", "get a panel on this", "review this from several angles", or when a high-stakes decision or document set needs several independent views and a single reviewer would anchor on one reading. Do NOT use for a single hostile reviewer (use red-team), for a quick code review, for search or lookup (use Explore), or for anything one agent can finish in a few tool calls.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r agent-council ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r agent-council .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/corpus-freeze.md`
- `references/dispatch-template.md`
